text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 205, May 31, 1939 ]
PRESCRIBING THE POLICY TO BE OBSERVED IN THE PROMOTION OF RETIRED OFFICERS OF
THE PHILIPPINE ARMY RECALLED TO ACTIVE DUTY
Pursuant to the authority vested in me by section twenty-two of Commonwealth Act Numbered One, known
as the National Defense Act, I, MANUEL L. QUEZON, President of the Philippines, do hereby prescribe the
following policy to be observed in the promotion of retired officers of the Regular Force in the Army of the
Philippines, who have been, or might hereafter be, recalled to active duty:
Any retired officer recalled to active duty shall be thereafter eligible for promotion in the retired list, while he
continues on such active duty, provided he is declared eligible for promotion by the Efficiency Board as
specified in Executive Order Numbered One hundred sixty-nine, dated October fifteenth, nineteen hundred
and thirty-eight, entitled “Regulation governing seniority, promotion, and elimination of officers of the
Regular Force, Philippine Army:” Provided, That such promotion shall be governed by seniority in the
corresponding grade or rank, seniority to be determined by the length of active service rendered in each grade:
And provided, further, That such promotion shall be made coincident with the promotion of the first regular
officer of less service in grade who may be promoted.
Done at the City of Manila, this thirty-first day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
thirty-nine, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the fourth.
MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
JORGE B. VARGAS
Secretary to the President
